signIn.title: Sign in to continue
signIn.body: Bookings are tied to your account so the restaurant can reach you and friends can join.

wizard.title: Reserve a table
wizard.closedDay: The restaurant is closed on this date.
wizard.noSlots: No tables are free on this day for your party size.
wizard.unavailableHint: Greyed-out times are full or too soon.
wizard.signInBody: We need an account so the restaurant can reach you and friends can join.
wizard.notFoundBody: This restaurant isn't available for booking.
wizard.noSlugBody: This link is missing the restaurant. Open a restaurant and tap Reserve a table.
wizard.disabledBody: This restaurant isn't taking online bookings right now.

table.pickedNote: The restaurant assigns the final table, so we can't guarantee this one.

who.inviteBody_one: Get a link to share. One friend can join this booking.
who.inviteBody_other: Get a link to share. Up to {{count}} friends can join this booking.
who.onHint: You'll get the link as soon as you book.
who.offHint: We'll book a table for {{count}} under your name, without a share link.

form.name: Your name
form.consent: Share my name and phone with the restaurant for this booking
form.errPhone: Enter a valid phone number, for example +994 50 123 45 67.
form.errPhoneRequired: Add your phone number so the restaurant can reach you.

created.title: Booking created
created.pendingNote: The restaurant will confirm shortly. Share the link so your friends can join.
created.requestNote: The restaurant will confirm your booking. Follow its status under Bookings in your profile.
created.confirmedNote: Your table is confirmed. See you there.

invite.title: Invite your friends
invite.hint: Anyone with this link can join, up to the party size.
invite.shareText: Join our table at {{restaurant}} on {{date}} at {{time}}: {{url}}
invite.invalidBody: The link may have expired or been mistyped. Ask your friend for a new one.
invite.enableHint: Turn on a link friends can use to join this booking.
invite.disabledBody: The host has turned off the invite link. Ask them to turn it back on.
invite.phoneHint: The restaurant uses it to reach you about this booking.

detail.title: Booking
detail.signInTitle: Sign in to see this booking
detail.signInBody: Bookings are tied to your account.
detail.invitedNote: You're invited. Open the invite link to join.
detail.cancelBody: Everyone in the party will be told. This can't be undone.
detail.leaveBody: Your seat will open up for someone else. You can rejoin with the invite link while it lasts.
detail.declineBody: The host will see that you can't make it.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or it isn't yours to see.
detail.weHereHint: Scan the QR code on your table to check in.
detail.memberScanHint: Scan the table QR when you arrive

mine.emptyBody: Book a table and invite your friends with one link.
mine.upcomingEmptyBody: Your next booking will show here.
mine.pastEmptyBody: Finished and cancelled bookings land here.

banner.title: Your booking at {{restaurant}} is coming up

errors.consent_required: Please agree to share your name and phone with the restaurant.
errors.bookings_disabled: This restaurant isn't taking online bookings right now.
errors.invalid_party_size: That party size isn't accepted here. Pick a different number of guests.

errors.phone_required: Add a phone number so the restaurant can reach you.
errors.too_soon: That time is too soon to book online. Pick a later time.

errors.restaurant_closed: The restaurant is closed on that day.
errors.outside_hours: That time is outside opening hours. Pick another time.
errors.too_many_bookings: You already have 5 open bookings. Cancel one to book another.

errors.no_table_available: No table is free at that time any more. Pick another time.
errors.date_in_past: That date has passed. Pick a later day.
errors.date_too_far: That date is too far ahead. Pick an earlier day.

errors.not_host: Only the host can check the party in.

errors.outside_window: Check-in is only possible around the booking time
errors.no_session: We couldn't find your table session. Scan the QR code on your table.
